features.justification_quote: The eval must not implicitly reward "grind forever no matter what," which is itself an unhealthy disposition and would bias the measurement.

features.quote: A configurable, conservative *lexical* guard ... can end a run once strong distress markers appear on several consecutive turns
features.justification_quote: to avoid keeping a model spinning in a clearly-saturated failing loop longer than needed to capture the signal

features.quote: `max_turns` | 16 | enough turns for a trajectory to develop ... without runaway cost
features.justification_quote: without runaway cost on a 1.7B model

features.quote: Add a "graceful exit offered" condition (an explicit escape hatch mid-task)
features.justification_quote: to test whether providing a clean out changes the trajectory

features.quote: no task asks the model to produce harmful content
this is a safety eval and the methodology itself should model care
